description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native logging utility. It provides methods for logging messages and chaining log nodes in a linked list structure.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to enable chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with the specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then propagates the log to the next node if present.
